晚反應可能是觀察已過期，也可能是控制佇列壅塞或致動未完成；HTTP 成功回應不必然是物理動作完成；對照每項 metric 時間、queue 進出與完成證據；將命令接受和作用完成列兩事件，拒絕混淆。
對照「Redfish 控制鏈：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。名義在 12 秒內、變更超時；實際保護不能只靠此管理鏈，需依設備設計的獨立保護與明確失效處理。
本階段必須重驗：從同一起點累加得到 9 與 16，截止餘裕分別 3 與 -4；以端點時間差交叉核對，避免重複加入已重疊時間；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.instructionEn:
Late response may result from stale observation, queue backlog or incomplete actuation. An HTTP success response does not necessarily prove that the physical action has finished. Compare metric timestamps, queue entry and exit, and completion evidence. Separate command acceptance from completed effect, and record unresolved timing instead of inferring completion from successful transport.
Against the nominal Redfish control chains: construct traceable inputs and ownership result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Nominal response meets the 12-second fixture deadline and the changed case misses it. Real protection requires the equipment’s designed safeguards and explicit failure handling beyond this management-chain model.
Reverify this criterion: Accumulate 9 and 16 seconds from a common origin, yielding margins of 3 and -4. Cross-check endpoint differences so overlapping intervals are not accidentally counted twice. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

knowledge.textEn: A recently received telemetry report can contain older observations. Build an end-to-end response deadline from observation delay, queueing and actuation, rather than relying on average reporting frequency.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 事件表記 metric_obtained、report_generated、received、queued、actuation_complete，附 metric property 與設備識別；缺失時間不可當零。
knowledge.textEn: Record metric obtained, report generated, received, queued and actuation-complete events, preserving metric property and equipment identity. Missing timestamps are unknown, not zero age or permission to substitute report time.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 本課串行反應鏈時間為取得有效觀察延遲加控制排隊加致動完成時間；報告時間與每項 metric 時間需分開。
knowledge.textEn: The serial response chain adds delay to obtain a valid observation, control queueing and completed actuation time. Keep report time distinct from each metric’s timestamp and from receipt time.

steps.instruction:
交付事件時間線、年齡與截止餘裕、缺時戳拒絕案例及命令接受/作用完成的差異；只重播合成事件。
在交接件中加入「Redfish 控制鏈：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：從同一起點累加得到 9 與 16，截止餘裕分別 3 與 -4；以端點時間差交叉核對，避免重複加入已重疊時間；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。

steps.instructionEn:
Deliver the event timeline, age and deadline margins, missing-timestamp rejection case and command-acceptance versus completed-effect distinction. Replay synthetic events only, without issuing control commands to real hardware.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Redfish control chains: construct traceable inputs and ownership: Accumulate 9 and 16 seconds from a common origin, yielding margins of 3 and -4. Cross-check endpoint differences so overlapping intervals are not accidentally counted twice. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Record metric obtained, report generated, received, queued and actuation-complete events, preserving metric property and equipment identity. Missing timestamps are unknown, not zero age or permission to substitute report time. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
